name: welldium
description: Search the Welldium catalog, build supplement plans and share them with your clients. Sign in with your Welldium practitioner account.

interface.longDescription: For practitioners on Welldium. Put together supplement plans for your clients from the Welldium catalog: search products with prices and stock for your client's country, draft a plan around a wellness goal, review and adjust it in chat, then share it with your client. You approve every change and nothing is sent to a client without your go-ahead.
